definitions.fullyNative: card status canonical and every emitted ability native+canonical; empty ability lists are counted separately
definitions.partlyNative: not fully native and at least one native claim, canonical or structured failure
definitions.noNativeClaim: not fully native and no native claim
definitions.auxiliary: token/double_faced_token/emblem/art_series layout, token/memorabilia set type, or Token/Emblem type
definitions.variant: non-auxiliary planar/scheme/vanguard layout or Plane/Phenomenon/Scheme/Vanguard/Dungeon type

opt_level_1_rejected.reason: small runtime gain and roughly four full audits to amortize the extra build
